label: Coupled Land–Atmosphere Modeling
title: Land–Atmosphere Interactions & Coupled Atmosphere–Hydrology Modeling
description: Fully coupled, convection-permitting WRF / WRF-Hydro modeling and water tagging to quantify how terrain, soils, and lateral water flow feed back on the atmosphere.

label: Agroecosystems & Land-Use Change

description: Process-based agroecosystem modeling and model–data fusion, and how land-use change, afforestation and land degradation affect land–atmosphere exchange.

title: Regional Water Cycle, Drought & Hydroclimate
